rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an irrational decision, argument, or idea.

example.english: Changing the whole plan without asking anyone was irrational.
example.traditional: 你冇問過大家就改晒個計劃，呢個決定好唔合理。
example.jyutping: nei5 mou5 man6 gwo3 daai6 gaa1 zau6 goi2 saai3 go3 gai3 waak6 ni1 go3 kyut3 ding6 hou2 m4 hap6 lei5

rows.note: Use this especially for an unreasonable demand, request, or way of treating someone.

example.english: Your demand that I finish everything today is irrational.
example.traditional: 你要我今日之內做晒全部嘢，個要求未免太無理喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 jiu3 ngo5 gam1 jat6 zi1 noi6 zou6 saai3 cyun4 bou6 je5 go3 jiu1 kau4 mei6 min5 taai3 mou4 lei5 laa3

rows.note: Use this for something absurd or nonsensical, especially in more formal or written contexts.

example.english: The claim that staying up late will make you taller is irrational.
example.traditional: 報告話捱夜就一定會長高，呢個講法實在荒謬。
example.jyutping: bou3 gou3 waa6 ngaai4 je6 zau6 jat1 ding6 wui6 coeng4 gou1 ni1 go3 gong2 faat3 sat6 zoi6 fong1 mau6
